statement: (n d : ℕ) (hd : d ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n) : d < n
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : d < n := by
    have h₂ : d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n := by
      -- Extract the fact that d is in Finset.Ico 1 n from the membership in properUnitaryDivisors n
      simp only [properUnitaryDivisors, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_singleton] at hd
      -- Simplify the condition to get d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n
      aesop
    -- Use the fact that d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n to get d < n
    have h₃ : d < n := Finset.mem_Ico.mp h₂ |>.2
    exact h₃
  exact h₁
